buildCommand: if [ "$WORKSPACE_MIGRATION_REHEARSAL" = "true" ] && [ "$VERCEL_ENV" != "production" ]; then node scripts/check-workspace-migration.mjs && npm run build; elif [ "$WORKSPACE_AUTH_ENABLED" = "true" ] && [ "$VERCEL_ENV" != "production" ]; then node --experimental-strip-types scripts/init-workspace-preview.mts && npm run build; else npm run ci; fi
